items.detail: **S&P 500 futures** rose 0.54% to 7,234.50 in Thursday's shortened holiday session, pointing to a higher open for Friday's half-day of trading, which ends at 1 p.m. ET.
items.why: Buyers came back to AI and chip stocks after Wednesday's late recovery calmed fears over the tariff plan.

items.detail: **Nvidia** heads into Friday's session under a cloud after S&P Global Ratings put its AA credit rating on **negative watch** over governance concerns.
items.why: The warning brings back doubts about the AI leader just as chip stocks try to recover from this week's rout.

items.detail: Traders now treat a quarter-point Fed rate hike at the **December 8–9** meeting as close to certain, and that is the main hurdle for stocks next week.
items.why: October's hot core inflation reading convinced markets the Fed has to keep raising rates.

items.detail: The **MSCI Emerging Markets** index is up **2.5%** this week, cutting its November loss to 7%, as Asian tech shares kept recovering Friday.
items.why: Investors went back into AI and chip stocks after Wednesday's rout, though EM is still set for a third straight monthly loss.

items.detail: The **Sensex** fell **0.75%** to 83,694 by midday Friday, giving back Thursday's IT-led gains as TCS, HCL Tech and Infosys dropped.
items.why: Brent crude above $96 on Middle East tensions and worries about US tariffs outweighed firmer Asian markets.

items.detail: South Korea's small-cap-heavy **Kosdaq** jumped **6.07%** Friday morning, well ahead of the Kospi, while India's Nifty Smallcap 100 also rose as the Sensex fell.
items.why: Bargain hunters went back into battered Korean growth stocks after the chip rout, and Indian buyers chose smaller companies over IT.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** climbed to about **$61,400** Friday ahead of a $6.8 billion options expiry, though the market's fear gauge is still at extreme lows.
items.why: Rising stock futures lifted risk appetite, but record ETF outflows of $5.39 billion this month are holding back the rebound.

items.detail: **Ether** edged back above **$1,700** Friday, its first move up from this week's lows, as about $600 million of options expired on Deribit.
items.why: Nine straight sessions of withdrawals from ether ETFs, about $1.3 billion this month, are keeping buyers cautious.

items.detail: **Solana** rose to about **$73** early Friday, adding to its bounce after holding the $65 level for a third time.
items.why: Solana ETFs ended a six-week run of outflows with $4.38 million of weekly inflows while bitcoin and ether funds kept losing money.

items.detail: **Gold** rose about 1.3% to **$3,615** Friday, back above $3,600 and extending its recovery from Wednesday's 15-month low.
items.why: A weaker dollar and bargain hunting in thin holiday trading lifted gold, though bets on a December rate hike limit the gains.

crossCuttingTheme: A recovery in AI and chip stocks after Wednesday's rout is lifting US futures, Asian tech shares and crypto together, and a softer dollar is helping gold, but a near-certain December Fed hike limits every rally.
